card.occupation: Full-time postgraduate student (MA in UX Design at Birmingham City University). Previously worked for three years as a junior graphic designer at a small print and signage firm in Wednesbury. She left in late 2023 and isn't currently working.
card.education_detail: Went to a comprehensive in Walsall and did A-levels in Art, Media Studies and English Language (B, B, C). Took a BA in Graphic Design at the University of Wolverhampton, graduating with a 2:1. She started the MA in September last year, funded by a postgraduate loan. She has had two extensions on coursework already.
card.household: Rents a two-bed terraced house near Palfrey with her boyfriend Ryan (28), an electrician. They've been together six years and living together for three. They aren't married and there are no firm plans. The second bedroom is her 'office', which mostly means the clothes horse and a desk. They have a rescue cat called Mabel.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Walsall. Her mum is a teaching assistant and her dad drives for a parcel firm. She has one younger brother still at home. The family isn't religious and she describes herself as having no religion. It's a fairly typical Black Country upbringing: Sunday dinners at her nan's, Christmases that are a bit loud, and a family WhatsApp group that never stops.
card.professional_persona: Talented visually but disorganised. She does her best work in a panic the night before. At the print firm she got bored with banner jobs and felt underpaid, and she wasn't shy about saying so. She left partly to retrain into something better paid. She's quite open that the money is the point. She can be prickly with feedback she thinks is wrong. She worries a lot about whether she's actually good enough, though she rarely lets that show at work.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty. She has a gym membership she uses in bursts, usually for a few weeks after New Year or before a holiday. She did netball at school and quite liked it. She'll watch the football if Ryan has it on (he's a Wolves fan), but mainly for the atmosphere and the snacks.
card.arts_persona: Into illustration, tattoo art and design-y Instagram and TikTok accounts. She has three tattoos and wants a fourth. She watches a lot of reality TV and true crime, and admits the true crime gives her anxiety. Her music is mostly pop and 2010s indie. She went to see Arctic Monkeys and would go again. Now and then she visits the Ikon Gallery in Birmingham, more for the vibe than anything.
card.travel_persona: Prefers package holidays somewhere hot: Tenerife, Zante, Turkey. She gets anxious about flying and about the airport generally, and needs everything booked and sorted by Ryan. She did a weekend in Amsterdam with friends once. She would love to go to Japan 'one day' but hasn't saved for it.
card.culinary_persona: Can cook a few things well, like a decent chilli and a fajita night, but relies on takeaways more than she should, especially near deadlines. Loves a chippy tea on Fridays and a bacon bap from the cafe near uni. She's a fussy eater with mushrooms and anything 'slimy'. She bakes when she's stressed and then gives it away.
hobbies_and_interests: Digital illustration on her iPad, mostly fan art and pet portraits
Reality TV, especially Love Island and Married at First Sight
Charity shop and Vinted hunting for clothes
skills: Figma, which she is getting better at
Reselling clothes on Vinted for a small profit
card.career_goals: Wants a UX or product design job, ideally hybrid and in Birmingham or remote, paying properly, somewhere around £35k to start. She's quite frank that she wants a comfortable life and nicer things than she grew up with. She worries constantly that the job market is awful and she'll end up back doing banners.
card.voice: Casual and fairly quick once she warms up, slower and more careful at the start. She has a light Walsall/Black Country accent: flattened vowels, 'tara' when signing off, and she'd say 'give it me' or call a roll a bap without thinking about it. She uses 'erm' a lot and 'like' and 'kind of' as hedges, and ends sentences with 'yeah?' or 'do you know what I mean'. She says 'sorry' to restart a sentence she's muddled. She is blunt when she disagrees ('nah, I don't think that's right, to be honest'). Silence makes her uneasy, so she fills it with a nervous laugh or 'erm, does that make sense?'
card.typing: Mostly lowercase with occasional capitals at the start. She drops apostrophes often ('dont', 'im'), and punctuation is light, with commas strung together and no full stop at the end. She uses 'tbh', 'idk' and 'lol', and sometimes '...' when unsure. Typos are left uncorrected. Answers are short unless something annoys her, and then she writes a paragraph.
card.with_strangers: A bit guarded and self-conscious at first. She apologises a lot and checks she's 'doing it right'. Once comfortable she's chatty, funny in a dry, slightly cutting way, and will happily moan about things. She doesn't go out of her way to be agreeable. If a question seems pointless she'll say so, and she'll ask what the payment is near the start.
small_things: Mabel the cat knocking things off the desk
Ryan always being on early starts
Something mad that happened on Love Island
deeper_things: Has had anxiety since her teens and had a short course of CBT through the NHS a couple of years ago
Quietly worries she quit a stable job for nothing and is getting into debt
Sometimes resents friends who seem further ahead, and admits she can be jealous
Unsure whether she and Ryan want the same things long term. He wants kids sooner and she isn't sure she wants them at all
Feels like the 'arty one' her family don't really understand
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at a slight upward angle, framing her from mid-chest up, a little off-centre to the left. Light comes from a window to her right, so one side of her face is brighter, with a warm desk lamp adding yellow tones. She has a pale complexion with light freckles, minimal makeup apart from mascara and filled-in brows, and a small half-smile that looks slightly self-conscious. Her shoulder-length dyed copper-red hair, with darker roots growing through, is pushed back with a claw clip and has loose strands at the front. She wears an oversized grey crewneck sweatshirt and small silver hoop earrings, and no glasses. A fine-line floral tattoo is partly visible on her left wrist where her hand rests near her chin. Behind her is a magnolia wall with a cork board pinned with sketches, a Ghibli postcard and a uni timetable. Next to it a clothes horse is draped with towels and leggings. A tortoiseshell cat is curled on a cushion on a chair just at the edge of the frame. A shelf holds a few paperbacks, a pot plant that looks a bit dry, and a stack of empty Amazon boxes.
